M15-019.title: FindFreePoseInBeacon: the candidate frame, grid, order and the three tests
M15-019.effect: where a carried cube is placed on the floor inside a beacon, and what a failed placement remembers
evidence: BehaviorExploreBringCubeToBeacon::FindFreePoseInBeacon 0x005E0378..0x005E0666 (static: r0 object, r1 beacon, r2 robot, r3 &out, float on the stack; the rest of 0x005E0378..0x005E139F is helpers and lambdas); frame = rotation about Z from the nearest cube in the beacon (CalculateDirectionalityClosest 0x005E07D8), else the robot-to-beacon heading via acosf, else angle 0

grid S = size.x + 10.0f (0x41200000), N = trunc(radius / S); order i = 0, -1..-N, then 1..N; for each i, j = 0, -1, +1, ..., -N, +N; candidate = beacon translation + R*(S*i, S*j, 0), parent = world origin; *out is written before any test
